definitions.gloss: to crawl under; to slip into (a space)
definitions.explanation: To physically get under or inside something, such as a blanket, a bed, or a narrow space.
To enter a place secretly or without authorization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}む。

examples.english: The cat crawled under the bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}くて→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{毛布|もうふ}→毛布：03630_moufu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}んで⟦{出|で}たくない→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: It's so cold that I've burrowed into my blanket and don't want to come out.

examples.japanese: ⟦スパイ→スパイ：18236_supai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}んだ。
⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}もうとした。
examples.english: I tried to sneak into the concert without a ticket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{身分|みぶん}→身分：00278_mibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}して→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The reporter concealed their identity and infiltrated the factory.

notes:
USAGE:
{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}む is a compound verb combining ⟦{潜|もぐ}る→潜る：03931_moguru⟧ (to dive, to go under) and ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into). The ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ suffix adds the nuance of going deep inside or fully entering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}む (to slip into a futon)
- ⟦ベッド→ベッド：04501_beddo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}む (to crawl into bed)
- ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}む (to infiltrate an organization)

Godan verb (mu-row): {潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}まない / {潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}みます / {潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}んで
